messages:
jamie: Heads-up — sampleapp embed+rerank e2e failing on node SDK. Reranker asserts vector length 1536 but SDK returns 1x1536 nested inside another array. Repro attached.

sam: Ugh. sampleapp prints:
```
console.log(embeddings.length, embeddings[0].length) // 1 1536
```
Should be 1536 not 1x1536? :facepalm:

lee: Quick note: our node SDK batch helper returns [[vec]] when batchSize===1 because it preserves per-request arrays. Python SDK flattens singletons. This causes parity issues for rerank which expects flat vectors.

tara: Is this a change in v0.3.1 or a regression? Any regression tests failing?

sam: Looks like sdk v0.3.1 introduced a "preserveStructure" refactor and docs weren't updated. Also noticed an auth+retry interaction — when token refresh happens mid-batch, the retry wrapper re-invokes the batch helper which can cause duplicate calls for the same request id. Sometimes that results in the server returning extra nesting downstream.

jamie: Minimal repro dump (node):
```js
// node sample
const out = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-ada-002', input: ['a'] })
console.log(JSON.stringify(out.data))
// observed: data: [[ [0.12, -0.03, ...] ]]
```

lee: Short-term workaround: map over results and if top-level length === 1 && Array.isArray(results[0]) && Array.isArray(results[0][0]) then set results = results[0][0]. Flatten one level when inner-most items are numbers.

sam: I pushed a tiny hotfix branch `devex/flatten-singleton` and added a unit test in `sdk/test/embed_parity.test.js`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412

tara: Can we also make the batch helper idempotent? Add a request-id header and dedupe in the retry wrapper so auth refresh doesn't rerun the same logical batch.

lee: Agreed. I'll implement dedupe + unit test for the auth-retry scenario and add an e2e that exercises rerank pipeline with single-item batches.

sam: QA note: update `sampleapp/README.md` to document node vs python parity and example response shapes so customers don't get surprised.

ci-bot: deploy queued for canary with tag `sdk-v0.3.2-hotfix` — 1805843600

jamie: Thanks team :thumbsup:
